en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Haroun Bin Muslim, from Mas’ada Bin Sadaqa, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Do not initiate the greetings with the women nor invite them to the meal, for the Prophet<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The women are inarticulate and exposed, therefore veil their inability to express themselves with the silence, and veil their exposure with the houses’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Harun ibn Muslim from Mas’adah ibn Sadaqah who has said the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that

’Amir al-Mu’minin has said, ’You must not initiate Salam (the phrase of offering greeting of peace) to women and you must not invite them for food; the Holy Prophet, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, “Women are tiredness (weakness in communication) and a matter of private nature thus, you must cover their tiredness with quietness and the privacy of their nature with homes.’””
